## AI disclosure

This contribution was prepared by an AI agent under the warren campaign `camp-openclaw-eod-v0` (agent `pi` on `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`), approved by jayminwest. It follows the repository's AI-assisted contribution policy: the work is disclosed here and carries validation evidence below.

## Problem

The scheduler test flakes on cold caches, producing intermittent CI failures unrelated to the change under test.

## Solution

Seed the scheduler's deterministic clock in the test setup so cold-cache ordering cannot vary between runs.

## Impact

Contributors see stable CI results for scheduler changes; no runtime behavior changes.
